text.en:
CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT (CHAPTER 84)

NOTIFICATION OF APPOINTMENT AS

REGISTRAR OF CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES UNDER SECTION 3(1) GN 514/1996

REVISED EDITION 2015

LAWS OF BRUNEI Co-operative Societies CAP. 84, N 2 1 [Subsidiary]

SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION Notification of appointment as Registrar of Co-operative Societies under section 3(1) His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has appointed the Director of Brunei Industrial Development Authority as Registrar of Co-operative Societies with effect from 18th July 1996.
